about_the_game:
Step into the world of Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure games — an immersive blend of storytelling, exploration, and puzzle-solving. In this genre, you don’t just watch the story unfold — you take part in it. Every scene challenges you to find cleverly concealed items, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and unlock the next twist in the mystery. It’s a journey that blends the thrill of discovery with the satisfaction of outsmarting every obstacle.

Claire Malone, a fearless vampire huntress disguised as a journalist, boards the opulent cruise ship Fortune’s Dream. What should have been a voyage of luxury quickly turns sinister: passengers vanish without a trace, and whispers of the supernatural spread through the corridors. Her investigation soon collides with Ethan Cross, the enigmatic ship owner whose secret is darker than the storm on the horizon. As danger closes in and loyalties fracture, Claire and Ethan must uncover the truth and confront the ancient Vampire Council before their voyage becomes humanity’s last.
Test your observation skills and wit with a variety of puzzles and mini-games. From classic hidden object scenes to inventive challenges, every moment pushes you to stay sharp and think ahead.

Features:

💕 Explore an unforgettable setting: moonlit decks, secret VIP lounges, eerie cargo bays, and high-tech surveillance rooms.

💕 Collect mysterious artifacts and decode hidden messages to piece together the truth.

💕 Solve immersive puzzles and captivating mini-games.

💕 Earn achievements and unlock crucial story revelations.

💕 Hunt through a wealth of hidden object scenes designed to keep your attention sharp.

Embark on a journey where mystery, danger, and romance collide — and every hidden object brings you closer to the heart of the truth.
